tools.name: contract-operations_clause-extract
tools.description: Extract numbered clauses, parties, defined terms, and a governing-law sentence from supplied contract text or a text-based PDF. Each item keeps a source excerpt. Missing headings stay unavailable. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/clause-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 paym

tools.name: contract-operations_obligation-extract
tools.description: Extract sentences that use shall, must, agrees to, is required to, or undertakes to, and name the party stated before the verb. Sentences that only say may are not turned into obligations. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/obligation-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: contract-operations_deadline-extract
tools.description: Extract stated periods, notice periods, and unambiguous calendar dates. Slash dates are not guessed, and a deadline is not created when the text gives no number or date. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/deadline-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not ru

tools.name: contract-operations_renewal-risk-check
tools.description: Read renewal and expiration wording that is actually printed. A notice date is calculated only from a stated expiration date and a stated notice period. Renewal wording is flagged as a potential risk, not a legal conclusion. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/renewal-risk-check. An u

tools.name: contract-operations_missing-clause-check
tools.description: Compare the contract with a checklist or with provisions supplied for a named standard. A standard name alone does not create required clauses, and similar wording is not inferred. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/missing-clause-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: contract-operations_version-diff
tools.description: Compare two supplied contract versions by clause number or heading. Whitespace and letter case alone are not reported. Clauses are not matched by meaning. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/version-diff. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: contract-operations_change-impact
tools.description: Label meaningful version changes as a date, a stated period, an obligation verb, or an added or removed clause. The legal effect of a change is not decided. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/change-impact. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: contract-operations_party-obligations
tools.description: Group extracted obligations under the party named before shall, must, or agrees to. An obligation that names no party stays unassigned. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/party-obligations. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: contract-operations_risk-summary
tools.description: Flag renewal, indemnity, unlimited-liability, and termination-for-convenience wording that is present in the text. These are potential risks, not a legal opinion or a risk score. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/risk-summary. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does n

tools.name: contract-operations_compliance-review
tools.description: Combine clause, obligation, deadline, renewal, checklist, party, and risk checks. checklist_satisfied means the supplied phrases were found. It is not a legal compliance determination. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/contract-operations/compliance-review. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "contract-operations" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check · Public sink: contract-operations_clause-extract, contract-operations_obligation-extract, contract-operations_deadline-extract, contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check, contract-operations_version-diff, contract-operations_change-impact, contract-operations_party-obligations, contract-operations_risk-summary, contract-operations_compliance-review · Destructive: contract-operations_clause-extract, contract-operations_obligation-extract, contract-operations_deadline-extract, contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check, contract-operations_version-diff, contract-operations_change-impact, contract-operations_party-obligations, contract-operations_risk-summary, contract-operations_compliance-review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check · Public sink: contract-operations_clause-extract, contract-operations_obligation-extract, contract-operations_deadline-extract, contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check, contract-operations_version-diff, contract-operations_change-impact, contract-operations_party-obligations, contract-operations_risk-summary, contract-operations_compliance-review · Destructive: contract-operations_clause-extract, contract-operations_obligation-extract, contract-operations_deadline-extract, contract-operations_renewal-risk-check, contract-operations_missing-clause-check, contract-operations_version-diff, contract-operations_change-impact, contract-operations_party-obligations, contract-operations_risk-summary, contract-operations_compliance-review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
